sources.title: GitHub - Sagargupta16/LeetCode_Rating_Predictor: Full-stack LeetCode ...
sources.snippet: LeetCode's rating is an Elo-style formula, and an exact replica needs the rating of every participant: a ranklist scrape of 30k+ rows per contest. This model needs only one user's own history, so the API answers a prediction with one GraphQL call, and the extension can annotate any ranking page on demand.
